data.situation: Before leaving home, Lin put the bag receipt in her notebook. At the bus stop she paid four pounds for a return ticket and tucked that slip inside her notebook. Back at the shop, the manager checked the broken handle and offered a new bag. Lin accepted the replacement, then laid the bus ticket beside the purchase receipt. They showed different costs. She was happy with the new bag. The extra bus fare was a separate expense. She wanted to discuss the extra journey the fault had required. The manager said the shop could reimburse her for this bus fare after checking the ticket. Lin repeated the amount to make sure they agreed: four pounds for travel, not thirty pounds for the order. She asked, "When will you reimburse me for the bus fare?" The manager wrote the amount and the planned payment date on a small card to the right. Lin kept it beside both slips. Now she knew when to expect the payment. She left with the new bag and a clear record of what had been agreed.
data.zhSupport: reimburse sb for sth 中，先说偿付给谁，再说为哪项开支。这里谈额外车费，与退回商品价款的 refund 区分。所有偿付安排来自虚构经理的现场说明，不表示普遍权利。
data.easySummary: Lin has a new bag. She asks the shop about the extra bus cost, keeps the ticket and checks the amount and date.

glossary.note: 原资料包含报销、退款、赔偿；本课选择把已经支出的公交费用付还给当事人的具体用法，不偷换为商品退款。
源 canonical 为 reimburse sb for sth；sb 与 sth 是语法占位，不照着说。实际用人称宾语与真实费用替换。
保存付款证明，供双方核对费用；并不保证提交后必定偿付。
说明已经付过费用的材料，如本故事的车票和收据；不设定普遍证据规则。
核对双方谈的是同一笔费用与同一个数额。

glossary.text: When will you reimburse me for ...?
glossary.zh: 什么时候会把……费用偿付给我？
glossary.note: 在对方已经答应处理该开支后，询问预计支付时间；不能用来暗示已获普遍退款权。

glossary.text: a refund of the purchase price
glossary.note: 本项目必要的对比语言块，不是新增教材源词；退商品价款与偿付额外支出分开。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The shop has replaced your bag. You paid four pounds to come back. Ask whether the shop will repay that travel cost.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 商店已经换了袋子。你为回店花了四英镑。询问是否会偿付这笔出行费用。
acceptableAnswers: Will you reimburse me for the bus fare?
Could you reimburse me for the extra bus fare?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Put the person after the verb and the expense after for. This is a request about this case.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 动词后说偿付给谁，for 后说明哪项费用；这是针对本次情况的请求。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The order cost thirty pounds and the return bus trip cost four. Ask the manager to confirm the travel amount and say what evidence you kept.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 订单三十英镑，回店车程四英镑。请经理确认出行偿付金额，并说明保留了票据。
acceptableAnswers: Could you confirm the amount? The bus fare was four pounds, and I kept the receipt.
I kept the receipt for the four-pound journey. Could you confirm the amount you will repay?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Identify the extra expense and its proof rather than the full product price.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 明确额外费用和它的证明，不把它混为商品总价。

retrievalPrompts.function: Ask when the agreed cost will be paid
retrievalPrompts.cue: The manager has agreed to repay the bus cost, but has not said when. Ask for a planned payment date.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 经理已同意偿付公交费用，但还没说时间。询问计划支付日期。
acceptableAnswers: When will you reimburse me for the bus fare?
Could you tell me when you will reimburse me for the bus fare?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask about timing after agreement and keep the expense clear.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 在对方同意后询问时间，并继续说清费用对象。
targetTerms: When will you reimburse me for ...?

transferPrompt.function: Request repayment in a different role
transferPrompt.cue: Your team asked you to print leaflets for an event. You paid eight pounds and kept the receipt. Ask the organiser if the cost can be paid back.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到团队活动：团队请你印传单，你花了八英镑并保留收据。向组织者询问是否可以偿付这笔费用。
acceptableAnswers: Could you reimburse me for the printing costs? I kept the receipt for the eight pounds.
Will you reimburse me for the printing costs? I have kept the receipt.
transferPrompt.feedback: Change both the person and the expense. Keep it a request until the organiser agrees.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 换人物与开支类型；组织者同意之前仍是请求。
